behavior_groups.assertion_scope: isolated mock state, ordered expectations, commit path
SQL whitespace normalization, argument arity/value matching, structured errors
column/row order, CSV NULL conversion, prepared query snapshot
driver result values/errors, metadata flags, scalar argument acceptance

adaptations: Callbacks, live database connections, context timing, delayed expectations, and example applications are excluded from the serializable deterministic boundary.
The bridge accepts JSON scalar driver values and snapshots returned rows; pointers, callbacks, filesystem handles, and live connections do not cross the boundary.
The frozen Go 1.15 source is adapted at Oracle/candidate runtime to the locked Go 1.26.5 directive; four legacy dynamic fmt.Errorf calls are rewritten to preserve their error text under Go 1.26 vet.
